programme.desc: The girls visit the Glitter Genie to learn glitter magic, but something is causing Shimmer to keep messing up. / The girls visit the Gem Princess, who takes them underwater to help gather crystals in the beautiful coral reef.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA

programme.sub-title: Nila Out of Water/I Dream of Zeta

programme.sub-title: A Lightning Colt for Shaya/A Special Delivery

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: The girls celebrate Cuddle Buddy Day by helping the Animal Genie deliver pets. But when Zeta uses a spell to make everything dark, the Animal Genie must team up with the Glitter Genie to make the pets glow so they can see.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Kaz worries he's not brave enough, he adventures with the kids to find a Bravery Gem to help him. / Nazboo finds a kazoo that makes magic stronger when you play it, including Zeta's.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: The girls join Zora, the Pirate Genie, on an adventure to find a magical Rainbow Pearl to power her ship. / Zeta takes a crystal with random wishes inside it and uses her magic to make it grant the wishes for her.
programme.sub-title: A Pirate Genie's Life For Me/Wacky Wishes

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When Zeta takes some of Ula's powerful gems, Shimmer, Shine, Leah, Nila and Ula must work together to stop her. When the girls go looking for the Zahramay Tea Flower, they run into cute little Fuzzle Whuzzles who complicate their quest.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Shimmer, Shine and Leah travel to a magical new land called Zahramay Skies and meet Adara, the Stardust Princess. But when Zeta shows up and lets all of Adara's stars loose, the girls must work together to retrieve the stars and save Zahramay Skies.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: When costumes get magically stuck on Shimmer, Shine and Leah, they must track down a special feather to undo the magic. Zeta impersonates the girls' potions teacher and tricks them into helping her brew a sneaky potion.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA
programme.desc: Shimmer and Zahrora accidentally cause some trouble when they visit a new part of Zahramay Skies called Zahraconia. The girls meet Shaya's twin brother Shaun and help them when their magic combines to form a powerful Lightning Burst Cloud.

programme.title: Shimmer and Shine CA

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après avoir lu le livre controversé de J.D. Salinger, 'L'Attrape-cœurs' Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny se lancent à leur tour dans l'écriture d'un roman. Mais la mère de Stan découvre leur prose.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le restaurant préféré de Cartman a fermé et laissé place à une pharmacie qui vend du cannabis médicinal. Randy essaie alors désespérément d'obtenir une prescription médicale pour pouvoir s'en procurer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Kyle, Stan et Kenny découvrent Facebook et les relations entre 'amis' virtuels. Malheureusement pour lui, Kyle accepte de devenir ami avec la mauvaise personne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cet été, l'heure n'est pas à la détente mais à la compétition. Jimmy et ses amis handicapés mettent tout en oeuvre pour être les champions du camp de vacances.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman rêve de devenir pilote de Nascar et est prêt à tout pour y parvenir. Comme il est persuadé qu'il faut être pauvre et stupide pour exceller dans cette discipline, il va tenter de se débarrasser de tout son argent et de ses neurones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour lutter contre l'invasion des habitants de New Jersey, la ville de South Park se mobilise et en vient à faire appel à Oussama Ben Laden.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: À la demande de Wendy Testaburger, Stan accepte de ranger son casier avec l'aide d'un groupe de 'spécialistes'.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon et ses amis sont disposés à aider les victimes de la marée noire provoquée par BP suite à un accident de forage dans le Golfe du Mexique.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Emmenés par Mystérion, les super-héros doivent résoudre la crise du Golfe et arrêter Cthulhu. Mais le Coon a d'autres idées en tête.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Le Coon se révèle être plus infâme encore que le Seigneur maléfique Cthulhu! Alors que le Coon punit ses anciens amis, Kenny tente de vivre avec le fardeau que représente son super-pouvoir.
programme.sub-title: Le Coon contre le Coon et sa bande

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: C'est la pagaille dans la vie de Stan, à la maison comme à l'école, à cause de l'obsession de Randy pour les chaînes culinaires. Et cela affecte même Sharon qui, se sentant délaissée, décide de faire du sport.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle n'ayant pas lu les petites lettres de son contrat, il est kidnappé par Apple, qui a de grands projets pour lui. Il appartient aux garçons de le sauver.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après que l'on se soit moqué de l'Allemagne lors des récompenses pour la comédie, les Allemands construisent une machine à rires: Funnybot. Cependant, ses projets pour l'humanité ne sont pas très réjouissantes.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La princesse canadienne est kidnappée pendant sa cérémonie de mariage, Ike est convoqué au Canada pour aider à la retrouver. Qui peut bien être l'auteur d'un tel crime?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après un incident embarrassant impliquant les parties des garçons, Cartman est envoyé en thérapie de 'gestion de la colère' et Randy fait de son mieux pour gérer les retombées.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Kyle découvre que Cartman se porte bénévole pour les bébés accros au crack dans l'hôpital de la ville, il commence à douter. Que fait Slash (des Guns n' Roses) dans tout ça?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Butters est pris dans une guerre de territoire asiatique, ses parents découvrent qu'il a plusieurs personnalités et décident que la seule solution est de lui administrer des médicaments.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pour son anniversaire, Stan reçoit en cadeau un CD de 'tween wave' mais ses parents lui interdisent d'écouter cette 'merde'. Stan se surprend à être d'accord avec eux, mais ses amis n'en sont pas impressionnés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Stan continue d'avoir sa crise existentielle alors que Cartman intègre le monde du hamburger avec un ingrédient super spécial, top secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un jeu de 'garde-frontières' termine mal et Butters finit par faire revivre la fierté mexicaine, mais Cartman n'est pas prêt à laisser le jeu se terminer ainsi.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque l'école primaire de South Park est victime d'un site internet dévoilant les secrets de tous, c'est l'hécatombe. Qui sauvera la situation? Cartman ou Gerbil King Lemmiwinks?

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Lorsque Randy apprend le secret qui se cache derrière la comédie musicale, il ne peut s'empêcher d'y emmener Sharon. Andrew Lloyd-Webber et Elton John le supplient de ne pas révéler leur secret.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les parents de Kenny sont arrêtés et il est placé dans une famille, Cartman devient alors l'enfant le plus pauvre de l'école ! Entre-temps, une mystérieuse figure masquée ressurgit du passé.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Après la visite à l'école d'un intervenant venu expliquer les affres du harcèlement, Stan décide de réaliser un clip vidéo (sous forme de lip dub) pour sensibiliser le reste du monde.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman, Stan, Kyle et Kenny partent en excursion dans les Rocheuses du Colorado pour y découvrir la tyrolienne. Le voyage des enfants va rapidement virer au cauchemar.
programme.sub-title: Je n'aurais jamais dû faire de la tyrolienne

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: L'arrivée d'une nouvelle camarade de classe de couleur va donner envie à Cartman de mettre en application ses conceptions personnelles sur l'amour et les races, en tentant de la faire tomber amoureuse du petit Token Black.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Randy Marsh change radicalement les règles du football à l'école élémentaire de South Park. Sa nouvelle version du jeu devient le sport le plus populaire du pays.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman prend conscience de son poids et décide de conduire un scooter pour handicapé. Kyle constate que de plus en plus de personnes mènent sans honte ce genre de vie autour de lui. C'est alors que Cartman se découvre une rivale.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle pense que sa mère a une liaison avec un livreur UPS. Lorsque la méfiance du public tombe sur lui, la livraison de colis dans le quartier est menacée, et Eric Cartman achète un système de sécurité.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Quand Butters sort de l'école, ses parents se rendent compte qu'il est temps de lui dire pourquoi il n'est pas comme tous les autres enfants. Il doit se rendre dans un lieu étrange pour apprendre les voies de son peuple.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Les préparatifs de Randy pour Halloween empêchent Stan de pouvoir aller à la chasse aux bonbons avec ses amis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Ayant appris que Jésus s'était dopé pour accomplir ses miracles, le monde se sent perdu et trahi. Les garçons, joints par le reste de la nation, retirent les bracelets jaunes symbolisant leur ancienne idole.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eric Cartman cache un terrible secret dans sa chambre à coucher qui pourrait changer les élections présidentielles 2012 aux États-unis.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Kyle est en colère contre Cartman qui a pris la mauvaise habitude de parler au téléphone avec le haut-parleur, et l'accuse de se mêler de sa vie privée. Cartman informe alors les autres élèves de l'école que le gouvernement les espionne.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Peter Mullen informe ses camarades de classe que ses parents (entre autres !) regardent 'Informative Murder Porn', une émission susceptible de les inciter à s'entretuer. Les enfants décident donc de bloquer les chaines.

programme.desc: Franky’s backstory continues! The sea train is a success, and it looks like Tom’s life is spared! Unfortunately, a government spy is searching for a reason to investigate Tom, and Franky provides the ammunition!
programme.sub-title: Spandam's scheme! The day the sea train shook!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Tom does the unthinkable in an attempt to protect his apprentices, but young Franky is unable to control his rage, leading to a showdown with a spy – and a train!
programme.sub-title: The end of the legendary man! The day the sea train cried!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper’s heroism may mean the difference between life and death for Iceberg and Paulie, Nami learns the agonizing truth about Robin, and Sanji prepares to make his move!
programme.sub-title: The truth behind her betrayal! Robin's sorrowful decision!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami makes a frantic dash for the Sea Train station, Chopper searches desperately for Zoro and Luffy, and Sanji plays it cool while waiting for the right time to spring into action.
programme.sub-title: The steam whistle forces friends apart! The sea train starts to run

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami arrives at the train station a minute too late, Sanji makes his presence aboard the sea train known, and the search for Luffy and Zoro continues!
programme.sub-title: Sanji barges in! Sea train battle in the storm!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Chopper and Robin risk their own lives in a desperate attempt to save Luffy and Zoro from a monstrous wall of water! Meanwhile, Sanji moves ever closer to a reunion with Robin.
programme.sub-title: Nami's soul cries out! Straw hat luffy makes a comeback!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy and Nami ask to borrow a ship so they can chase down the sea train, but the weather is too severe to set sail. Lucky for them, Iceberg and his friends are full of surprises!
programme.sub-title: Another sea train? Rocketman charges forth!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy, Zoro, Chopper, and Nami rocket toward a rendezvous with the assassins of CP 9, but they’ll need to forge an alliance with some new friends to have any chance at survival!
programme.sub-title: Rescue our friends! A bond among foes sworn with fists!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro and Luffy go head-to-head with Mother Nature, and Sanji’s rescue mission is bolstered by Franky’s allegiance – and the arrival of the mysterious Sniper King!
programme.sub-title: Smash the wave! Luffy and zoro use the strongest combo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sniper King, a mysterious warrior from the island of snipers, lends a hand as Franky and Sanji try to fight their way to Robin.
programme.sub-title: A mysterious man appears?! His name is sniper king!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Sanji mixes it up with a deranged cook, Franky dukes it out with the newest member of CP9, and the Sniper King gets creative in his attempt to reach Robin!
programme.sub-title: Showdown between cooks! Sanji vs. Ramen kenpo!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Franky and Sanji continue to battle the thugs of CP9. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the gang find themselves headed for a collision that could spell doom for everyone!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro faces a fellow master of the blade, Sanji looks to end his fight against a rampaging ramen master, and Franky finally lands a big blow against his CP9 foe!
programme.sub-title: Clash! Demon-slasher zoro vs. Ship-slasher t-bone!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Sniper King hatches a daring escape plan, but the assassins of CP9 are more powerful than our heroes ever imagined. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang run into a very familiar frog!
programme.sub-title: Scramble over robin! A cunning plan by sniper king!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: As their train approaches Enies Lobby, Franky’s kind words cut through Robin’s cold exterior. Luffy’s train is thrown off course, but the group gains a powerful new ally!
programme.sub-title: The judicial island! Full view of enies lobby!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: The Straw Hats hatch a plan to rescue Robin, but as usual, Luffy can’t wait to find a fight. Will his impulsive attack derail their mission?
programme.sub-title: Landing operations start! Charge in, straw hats!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy manages to reach the main island, but the Franky Family’s assault is stopped short by a couple of angry giants!
programme.sub-title: Luffy cuts through! Big showdown on the judicial island!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy makes short work of a few hundred marines, the Franky Family takes down a giant, and the assassins of CP9 report back to Spandam!
programme.sub-title: Battle against giants! Open the second gate!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Zoro’s quick thinking – and a little help from a giant frog – sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!
programme.sub-title: Find a way out! Rocketman takes flight!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Nami electrocutes the enemy with a Clima Tact attack, but the bad guys have the Straw Hats surrounded until the Franky Family shows up with a couple of sea monsters!
programme.sub-title: Catch up with luffy! The straw hats' all-out battle

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: Robin betrayed! The motive of the world government!

programme.title: One Piece

programme.sub-title: Don't stop! Hoist the counterattack signal!

programme.sub-title: Almost to luffy! Gather at the courthouse plaza!

programme.title: One Piece
programme.desc: Luffy batters a baffled Blueno with his powerful new fighting style, and the cowardly Spandam begins to panic at the sound of the Straw Hats approaching!
programme.sub-title: Everything is to protect my friends! Second gear activated!

programme.sub-title: The tragedy of ohara! The terror of the buster call!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you newlyweds suffering Honeymoon Hangover? The Bahamas vacation is over, the dress is put away and couples realize they now have this to face: Married Life. Dr. Phil discovers how little couples know about each other before they walk down the aisle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explored the topic of infidelity on a recent show sparking debates and thousands of viewer responses. Dr. Phil addresses a flood of comments on his social media and answers the question: "Is it possible to make your marriage affair-proof?" Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: For the past 2 years Nancy has been in an online relationship with "Shaun" she says is an honest and loving man. Her son Darcy says Nancy doesn't even know what he looks like! Nancy is adamant she is not being scammed in this catfish story of online love.
programme.sub-title: Talk To Dr. Phil Or We're Done Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Amanda, 25, says she was molested over 795 times by her father, Earl Nix, a secret when revealed to family was rejected despite Nix being convicted of first-degree criminal sexual conduct. The family comes face-to-face in an emotional attempt for truth.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Thirty-year-old mom of four, Melissa Dilan-Hernandez, made headlines when arrested and charged with having sex with her 17-year-old fiancé, T.J. The couple sits down with Dr. Phil to justify their relationship. Plus, does T.J.'s father approve?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when a household is in total meltdown and filled with constant battles? Meet a mother who is afraid of her 17-year-old son and the stepfather who says he's caught in the middle. But is the boy the only one to blame for the chaos in the house?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Emotions run high when Kim’s sisters meet boyfriend Stacy for the first time and Dr. Phil reveals a shocking secret from Stacy’s past. What explanation does Stacy offer? How much did Kim know? Plus, Dr. Phil's advice for the family moving forward. Part 2
programme.sub-title: A Sister Intervention: The Boyfriend's Sordid Past Revealed Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Katlynn, Zach & Amber say dad Todd prioritizes everything over them: job, wife & new family. They say their dad missed weekend visits, failed to pay child support & even wrote a letter denouncing his parental rights. Could Todd do more or just a bad rap?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tom and Karen say Madison, 15, is out of control. Tom has served seven tours of duty in the Middle East commanding troops but says he's faced his scariest and most dangerous enemy in his own home. Fearing for their lives, they need Dr. Phil’s help. Part 1
programme.sub-title: Police Called 100 Times On Our Car Stealing, Drug Taking, Dad Beating, Beautiful 15-Year-Old Daughter, Who Is Now Corrupting Her Younger Sister Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Susie says she's at the end of her rope raising her 4-yr-old granddaughter & says daughter Adriana, 20, neglects her duties to spend time boyfriend Matt. Adriana strongly denies. Matt says he's judged for past drug use. Don't miss this emotional Dr. Phil.
programme.sub-title: I'm Raising My Granddaughter Because I Think My Daughter Is Violent, Abusive & Neglectful

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every parent can tell you that raising a child is often demanding, thankless, hard work. But when a teenager gets pregnant and has a child, the result can be stress and chaos.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Melvin says he is torn between his wife of eight years, Rachel, and his girlfriend of two years, Chantelle, and he wants Dr. Phil to help decide whom he should choose. When the women meet face to face for the first time, does Dr. Phil help him choose?
programme.sub-title: My Wife Or My Girlfriend, Dr. Phil, You Decide

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: At 700 lbs., Pauline, 48, has a Guinness World Record title of Heaviest Living Woman. Pauline is also a mother, daughter & friend with hopes and dreams of a better life for herself & her 18-year-old son Dillon. Can Dr. Phil help get her life on track?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meet three women ready to divorce controlling, chauvinistic husbands. At Dr. Phil's Man Camp, an intensive week-long stay in The Dr. Phil House, can these couples repair the damage from their toxic attitudes, explosive fights and abusive behaviors? Part 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kristle, Kayla & Patrick say mom Sherry has blown a $250,000 inheritance in 11 months, with $500 bar tabs & new motorcycles. But that's not it. They say mom takes non-prescribed pills, washes them down with rum & has pulled out a loaded gun while arguing.
programme.sub-title: A Blown Inheritance And Threats With A Loaded Gun: Our Mother Is Out Of Control

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, once made millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. Dr. Phil asks Ryan tough questions.
programme.sub-title: Our Son Was Making Millions, But Is Now Living In Our Garage With His Girlfriend

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany says boyfriend Tim is evil, abusive & unfaithful. Tim admits that he can't control his rage & choked Brittany while holding their 6-month-old daughter & says he fears he'll hurt the baby next. Tim confesses to cheating with both men and women.
programme.sub-title: Broken Bones, Broken Hearts, Broken Engagements?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Leah says mom Dora appears sweet but she's actually a narcissist, hypochondriac, drama queen & liar. Can this mother-daughter find common ground and rebuild? Plus Carrie says mom Paula, 61, has been meeting strangers online having sex. Dr. Phil weighs in.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Pregnancy is a time of baby showers, nesting, indulging food cravings and being pampered. But Dr. Phil’s guests, Shayna, says she's been pregnant more than a year, and Zona, says she's been pregnant over 3 1/2 years, Both are looking for answers why.
programme.sub-title: A Woman Claims To Be Pregnant For 3 Years 7 Months

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sarah, 46, has sent over $1 million to her boyfriend, “Chris,” whom she has only met online. She says she dreams about marriage, once he’s able to return to the U.S. from Africa. Dr. Phil’s Facebook followers joined the effort to track down the man!
programme.sub-title: I Believe My Cousin Is Squandering Her Inheritance On A Love Scam

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jana & Allen say neighbors Maritha & Melanie moved into the neighborhood: police reports, DFS, threats & their 4 dogs bark all hours of the night! Maritha & Melanie point to Jana & Allen, with Melanie being charged with misconduct for mooning a neighbor!
programme.sub-title: Neighbor Feud Erupts With Constant Calls To The Police, False Allegations, Trumped Up Charges, And Threats Of Violence

programme.title: Love Island
programme.desc: The temperature's rising and there are plenty more surprises in store. As ever, nothing is quite what it seems in paradise. And with that cash prize of £50,000 up for grabs for the winning couple in seven weeks' time, everyone wants to couple up.
